label: v199
changes: The document reader was giving up 20 seconds in — and hiding it. Reading a lease properly takes about 45 seconds; past 20 the app quietly abandoned the read and showed you a plain word search instead, laid out exactly like a real answer. That is why a question about repairs came back as three paragraphs about storm insurance. The limit now matches how long the work actually takes.
If a read ever does fall back, the app says so on screen and offers to read it properly, instead of presenting a word search as the answer.
Fixed the "answered by an earlier version of the reader" note appearing on brand-new answers. It was showing on every single read, which made the one notice that matters worthless.
